designed_relationships: cat-fixtures unit costs rise about 18 % from 2026-01 (cost_versions valid_from 2026-01-01) while unit prices stay unchanged, so fixtures contribution margin rate falls from 2026-01.
reg-west discount rate roughly doubles from 2026-03 (probability .35 -> .55, depth x1.45, reason_code promo), visible as allocated discounts / gross sales by region and month.
enterprise customers in cat-apparel return about 3x the rate of other segment/category combinations (return probability 0.156 vs 0.052 per shipment line).

injections.description: 3 orders with a malformed currency: ord-002141='US$', ord-002021='usd', ord-001005='EU'; their lines, discounts, shipments, shipment lines and returns are in the files too.
injections.expected_handling: C01/validate_batch rejects exactly these orders and every dependent row with CURRENCY_NOT_ISO4217; raw rows are kept; none enters the population.

injections.description: 2 cost versions whose valid_to runs one month (to 2025-11-01) into the next version of the same product, so 2025-10 has two matching versions.
injections.expected_handling: 31 shipment lines in 2025-10 are quarantined with COST_VERSION_AMBIGUOUS.

injections.description: prod-0007 has no cost version in 2026-02 (one version ends 2026-02-01, the next starts 2026-03-01).
injections.expected_handling: 15 shipment lines in 2026-02 are quarantined with COST_VERSION_MISSING.

injections.description: 2 daily FX rows are absent (rate_ids are skipped in the sequence).
injections.expected_handling: shipment lines of 5 shipments on those dates are quarantined with FX_RATE_MISSING; never defaulted to 1.0.

injections.description: 1 duplicate shipment line row (same shipment_line_id). Kept in data/injection-events.json, not in the entity file, because seeding would collide on the primary key.
injections.expected_handling: replayed through C01 it adds no row; freight allocation is keyed by shipment_line_id so a repeated C04 returns 409 FREIGHT_ALREADY_ALLOCATED.

injections.description: 4 returns exceeding the remaining quantity. Kept in data/injection-events.json as C03 inputs.
injections.expected_handling: C03 rejects each with RETURN_EXCEEDS_REMAINING; nothing is written.

injections.description: 1 return with a negative credit. Kept in data/injection-events.json as a C03 input (not in the entity file: the database CHECK credit_amount >= 0 would fail the seed).
2 customers change region mid-series: cust-0032 reg-east -> reg-south on 2025-09-01; cust-0039 reg-south -> reg-north on 2026-02-01.
injections.expected_handling: each shipment line takes the customer version effective at shipped_at (type-2).

injections.description: 3 customers whose only version starts 20 days after their first shipment.
injections.expected_handling: earlier lines resolve to region UNASSIGNED, shown as its own row.

injections.description: 5 orders cancelled before shipment (status cancelled, lines kept, no shipments).
injections.expected_handling: no shipment lines; never in the reporting population.

injections.description: 2 orders with every unit_price 0.00 (zero gross) and nonzero shipping_cost (18.50 or 24.75).
injections.expected_handling: freight allocates by shipped quantity, so residual stays 0.00 and contribution carries the cost.
